supersedes: The predecessor run's RULES.json + harness_results.json were WITHDRAWN: its baseline arm was degenerate (all concept row counts zero on a 214-row bundle, concept list not the accepted one) and its leg replay reported de=0.0 where the accepted record has de=2/2, 2/5, 1/2. Its OUTCOME_B verdict was therefore not admissible and is preserved only as a negative/withdrawn artifact.
question: Does ONE deterministic, corpus-derived, free, in-budget query-expansion layer raise (i) per-concept row coverage of the question's own frozen core concepts and (ii) recall of the frozen controlling-authority id sets in the language(s) the query was NOT asked in, on the three accepted served questions (de-kapitalverletzung, fr-bail-entretien, it-responsabilita-medica of packet rebuilt-39027045675) and the four frozen reality-check legs, with zero regression on any frozen retrieval gate?
hypothesis: The accepted failures are language-ASYMMETRIC rather than corpus-absent: the shipped baseline issues the question's own-language text with an empty expansion lexicon (terms_added == [], language_filter == null, machine_translation_used == false) and the accepted product EXPANSION table has no entry for the three questions' core concepts, so cross-language cells and compound nouns are lexical gaps.

authority_recall_definition.implementation: DELEGATED, byte-identical: evaluation.retrieval_gate.gates.match_authorities(authority_ids, rows, min_len=6). This harness never re-implements id matching.
authority_recall_definition.row_filter: row['language'] == target_language for the per-language cells; no language filter for the union cell
authority_recall_definition.recall: len(hits) / len(authority_ids); a leg with authority_ids == [] is NOT MEASURABLE and is never counted as a pass (matches the accepted gate semantics)

pool_per_arm.A0_baseline_shipped: the accepted benchmark record's own cached rows, channel == 'baseline' (24 embedded cached queries, from_cache == true, network_calls == 0)
pool_per_arm.A1_candidate: union of A0 rows and the candidate expansion rows for that (slug, language), deduplicated by canonical_decision_id then decision_id (product rule)
pool_per_arm.A1_candidate_only: the candidate expansion rows alone (secondary, reported but NOT the headline)

authority_recall_definition.failing_cells_at_freeze: the six fr/it per-language cells accepted at 0 hits: corporate-criminal-liability fr 0/2, it 0/2; business-judgment-rule fr 0/5, it 0/5; petty-theft-dismissal fr 0/2, it 0/2

concept_coverage_definition.implementation: DELEGATED, byte-identical: product.query.concept_coverage.coverage_report(query, decisions). This harness never re-implements concept extraction or matching.
concept_coverage_definition.concepts: content_concepts(question_text) — de-accented lowercase alnum tokens, length >= MIN_CONCEPT_CHARS (5), accepted generic STOPWORDS removed, order preserved, capped at MAX_CONCEPTS (8)
concept_coverage_definition.row_text: decision_text(row) = norm(full_text + regeste + snippet + title), NFKD de-accented casefolded
concept_coverage_definition.covered: rows_per_concept[concept] >= MIN_ROWS_PER_CONCEPT (2); under_covered is the complement
concept_coverage_definition.measured_on: THE QUESTION'S OWN TEXT IN EVERY ARM. Expansion terms are appended to the QUERY STRING SENT TO RETRIEVAL, never to the text whose concepts are scored. Scoring expansion terms as if they were the question's concepts is a defect, not a result.
concept_coverage_definition.charter_permissive_note: per-concept raw row counts are published alongside the >= 2 covered/uncovered verdict so the permissive >= 1-of-set reading is also visible

arms.A0_baseline_shipped: the accepted product baseline exactly as shipped: one OpenCaseLaw /decisions search per question, query = the question's own text verbatim, language_filter null, sort=relevance, fields=full, offset=0, limit=50, NO expansion. For the frozen legs this is the accepted record's cached channel=='baseline' rows, byte-reused.
arms.A1_candidate: A0 plus exactly ONE additional deterministic expansion query per (question, target language); retrieval parameters otherwise identical to A0 (same endpoint, sort, fields, offset, limit, language filter).
arms.A2_blanked_control: candidate algorithm executed with an EMPTY term set; must reproduce A0 exactly and must score STRICTLY BELOW A1 on both axes
arms.A3_shuffled_control: candidate algorithm run for question i but with the term set mined for question j != i (deterministic rotation over the served question list); must NOT raise coverage on question i

must_be: free (no paid API, no model call)
must_not: rebuild the retrieval adapter, cache, pagination, normalization or dedup
modify any frozen file, packet byte, rubric, bar or threshold
touch the classifier, abstention contract, geometry, clustering or layout
require network at import or construction time
algorithm: 2. Corpus sample S (read-only, zero network) = the three served bundles' decision rows (regeste/title/snippet/citation) + the accepted benchmark record's 24 embedded cached query rows (text_head/citation strings/language).

3. For each target language L and concept c, mine L-language expansion terms: documents of language L whose normalised text contains concept_prefix(c); score each candidate token t (alphabetic, len >= 5, not in the accepted STOPWORDS, t != c) by w(t) = df_L(t | contains c) / df_L(t); keep the top N_TERMS_PER_CONCEPT (4), tie-broken by token ascending.
4. Compound decomposition: strip the frozen per-language head-noun suffixes to obtain the modifier stem and head stem; keep stems of length >= 5.
5. Merge accepted product EXPANSION synonyms (product.query.retrieval.EXPANSION) for exact token matches, then mined terms, then stems; de-duplicate preserving order.
6. Emit ONE expansion query string = the joined terms, capped at MAX_QUERY_TERMS (12).
candidate_expansion_layer.emits: one additional query variant per (question, target language) plus one additive provenance.query_expansion object

outcome_A_promote.recall: A1 raises recall in at least 2 of the 6 accepted failing fr/it per-language cells
outcome_A_promote.coverage: A1 reduces under_covered count on at least 2 of the 3 served questions
outcome_A_promote.non_regression: every frozen gate that passes in accepted record 39117425713 still passes with A1 rows in the pool
outcome_A_promote.vacuity: A2 strictly below A1 on both axes, and A3 does not raise coverage on its target question

thresholds.outcome_B_bounded_negative: any failure of the above; publish the exact unrecoverable cells and the measured lexical cause, then stop

latency_budget.rule: one search call must return in < 30 s; the whole live pass must finish in < 240 s; every added call is disclosed with its measured wall time and any breach is named

thresholds.decision_count_bounds: A1 may not drop any A0 decision id from the union pool; dedup by canonical_decision_id then decision_id; provenance and query_result_bundle contract fields must remain additive and backwards-compatible

claim_ceiling: No artifact may assert that a map helps a jurist, that any authority is absent from the corpus, that any frozen bar is met or moved, or that any packet is fit to serve. Usefulness remains the human product gate's question and admission remains fail-closed. Concept-coverage counts are lexical coverage of a retrieved set, not a legal conclusion, and a zero count is a retrieval signal, not proof of corpus absence.
freeze_discipline: This file is committed BEFORE any measurement. Freeze ordering is demonstrated from the git commit time of the RULES.json commit versus the first commit containing any measurement. A hand-written frozen_at_utc field is NOT evidence. Any threshold or definition edit after a number has been seen invalidates the run and must be declared.
